name: cx-sequence~p1
task: First find the key and then pick it up. After that, open the locked door, enter the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: R2, the hard Existence(has_matching_key), is redundant — the chain Precedence(key_found, has_matching_key) with Precedence(has_matching_key, target_door_open), Precedence(target_door_open, target_room_entered), Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up), and Existence(target_picked_up) already forces has_matching_key, so every finishing run includes it (as the clues confirm). Remove Existence(has_matching_key); keep the chain and Existence(target_picked_up).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The chain Existence(target_picked_up) with Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up), Precedence(target_door_open, target_room_entered), Precedence(has_matching_key, target_door_open), and Precedence(key_found, has_matching_key) expresses the full order (find key, pick it up, open door, enter room, pick up ball). Existence(has_matching_key) is redundant but harmless since has_matching_key is an earlier step of the chain already forced; a minor cleanup would be dropping it, but the machine accepts the same runs and the candidate is correct.

After opening the locked door, enter the target room.
Enter the target room before picking up the ball.
